title: Sina toot gaii hai
body:
Sina toot gaii hai
Haaye haaye
Bano kaha talash kare apne laal ko..
Jangal me maardala hai zehra ki aal ko..
Bano kaha talash..
Shabbir laarahe hai maidaa'n se dekhiye
Haye Shabbir laarahe hai maidaa'n se dekhiye..
Apne zaiif kandhe pe athhara saal ko..
Bano kaha talash..
